Paste the reference numbers (for example the WhatsApp message with the numbers), pick photos of the bills, or choose saved bills. The app opens each bill, saves it as a picture and shows them all at the end.\n\nIf the FESCO page shows a code, type it and tap Search; everything else happens by itself.
